name: Squash-and-stretch bounce
visual_intent: An object drops and bounces with physical timing: stretched while falling fast, squashed on contact, each rebound lower and quicker. Gives weight and material to simple shapes.
implementation_summary: Entrance: fall with power2.in while stretched, then per contact a 50 ms squash and 100 ms recovery; rebound heights decay geometrically and their durations by the square root of the decay (free-fall timing). Scales about the base (transform-origin 50% 100%).
runtime_api: Studio.space.bounce(tl, target, at, {height, bounces, decay, squash, fall, stagger})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (settles at rest with scale 1) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
